title: He's Your Son
description: While baking alone in the kitchen, Grandma gets a phone call from a grandchild complaining that Dad grounded them and made them clean their room. The grandchild has a simple solution: since Dad is Grandma’s son, maybe she can make him stop.
alt: In a cozy kitchen, Grandma stands alone baking and talking on the phone while wearing an apron labeled 'Grandma.' A grandchild on the phone says, 'Grandma, Dad grounded me and he’s making me clean my room!' Grandma replies, 'Well, what do you want me to do about it?' The grandchild answers, 'He’s your son. Can’t you make him stop?'
